clue.text: Matchmaker to run the gauntlet

definitions.meaning: someone who arranges introductions between two parties is an intermediary
running the gauntlet means passing between two lines of attackers

explanation.surface: A matchmaker must take punishment from both sides.
explanation.definitionFit: An intermediary is a matchmaker; and running the gauntlet means passing along the gap between two rows of people.

clue.text: Poet or mighty man?

definitions.meaning: Longfellow's village smith is a mighty man, and a worker in gold is a kind of smith

explanation.surface: Is he a poet or a strongman?
explanation.definitionFit: Oliver Goldsmith wrote The Deserted Village; a craftsman in precious metal is a smith, recalling Longfellow's 'a mighty man is he'.

clue.text: Little creeper has a kind of horn

definitions.meaning: a brass instrument for military calls

explanation.surface: A small climbing plant comes with a horn.
explanation.definitionFit: Ajuga is a creeping plant of this name; the military brass instrument shares it.

clue.text: Birthday of the marathon man?

parts.note: the nursery rhyme says the child born on a certain weekday has far to go, like a long-distance runner

explanation.surface: When was the long-distance runner born?
explanation.definitionFit: In the rhyme 'Monday's child', the fifth weekday's child has far to go.

clue.text: Omission when lies slip out

indicators.note: out says the letters of lies slip come out in a new order

explanation.surface: Something left unsaid when a falsehood escapes.
explanation.definitionFit: Three dots in print mark words left out, an omission.

clue.text: Game opponents to bad-tempered old lion

parts.note: in bridge, North and East sit as opponents
mean can mean nasty or bad-tempered

explanation.surface: Competitors line up against a grumpy ageing lion.
explanation.walkthrough: In bridge North-South play East-West, so N and E are opponents. Heracles killed the lion of Nemea in his first labour.
explanation.definitionFit: The mythical lion slain by Heracles came from Nemea, so the old beast is described by that adjective.

clue.text: Form quick opinion of amount raised

parts.note: an amount or total is a sum
raised means up

explanation.surface: Someone sizes up a sum of money that has been collected.
explanation.definitionFit: To size someone up quickly is to make a rapid judgement of them.

clue.text: Makes sense to speak about metal mounting

indicators.note: about means the word for speaking goes round the other piece

parts.note: to say is to speak

indicators.note: in a down clue mounting means the word for metal reads upward

parts.note: tin is a metal

explanation.surface: A speech that makes sense, about metal being mounted.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mounting' turns TIN into NIT, and 'about' puts SAY around it.
explanation.definitionFit: Soundness of mind is common sense.

clue.text: "This — of parsons is mighty offensive' (Johnson)

parts.note: the solver fills the gap in a quotation from Samuel Johnson, who disliked jollity in clergymen

explanation.surface: Dr Johnson complains about the behaviour of clergymen.
explanation.walkthrough: Johnson's remark, recorded by Boswell, was that the jollity of parsons was mighty offensive; the gap takes a word meaning jollity.
explanation.definitionFit: Jollity, the quality Johnson disapproved of in clergy, is a synonym for the missing word.

clue.text: Cause damage having leapt forward losing head

indicators.note: losing head means the first letter of the word for leapt is dropped

parts.note: sprang means leapt forward

explanation.surface: Someone causes damage after jumping ahead and losing their temper.
explanation.definitionFit: To crash or damage a car or plane is British slang for a collision.

clue.text: This cricket shot's a joke

definitions.meaning: a stroke that sweeps the ball round to the leg side in cricket
a hoax or tease played on someone

explanation.surface: A batsman's stroke is laughable.
explanation.definitionFit: In cricket a pull to the leg side is such a stroke; a teasing hoax is the idiom for a playful deception.

clue.text: Island needs junior accountant

parts.note: junior means minor, lesser or younger
CA is chartered accountant

explanation.surface: An island community is in need of a trainee bookkeeper.
explanation.definitionFit: Menorca is one of the Balearic islands in the Mediterranean.

clue.text: It's easy to see through these gambles

definitions.text: It's easy to see through these
definitions.meaning: spectacles, which you look through to see clearly

explanation.surface: Risky bets are transparent.
explanation.definitionFit: Glasses help eyesight; informally, speculative investments are also so called, short for speculations.

clue.text: Toy with idea of night out after The Cocktail Party perhaps

indicators.note: after places the rearranged word behind the play in the answer

parts.note: The Cocktail Party is a play by T. S. Eliot

indicators.note: out signals that the letters of night are put out of order

explanation.surface: Someone fancies a night on the town after a drinks party.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out' rearranges NIGHT into THING, which neatly also means an idea, as the surface hints; 'after' puts it behind PLAY.
explanation.definitionFit: A child's toy is something to amuse oneself with, an object for amusement.

clue.text: Even air pressure is delivered by this sort of line

definitions.text: Even air pressure is delivered by this sort of line

parts.words: Even air pressure is delivered by this sort of line
parts.note: weather maps join points of equal atmospheric pressure with lines of a particular kind

explanation.surface: A line that brings smooth pressure, as if from a delivery service.
explanation.definitionFit: Lines on weather charts linking places of equal barometric reading carry this adjective.

clue.text: Perhaps no ink is on the paper because it's so thin

indicators.note: perhaps signals that the letters of no ink is on could be arranged another way

explanation.surface: A page so thin that perhaps no ink sits on it.
explanation.definitionFit: Very thin translucent writing sheets are named after the papery layer of a bulb.

clue.text: The band is a hit

definitions.meaning: a strap worn around the waist

explanation.surface: The group has a chart success.
explanation.definitionFit: A strap round the waist and a heavy punch both share this word.

clue.text: Likely state of the poll as time goes by

definitions.text: Likely state of the poll as time goes by

parts.words: Likely state of the poll as time goes by
parts.note: the poll is the head, which tends to lose its covering with age

explanation.surface: An opinion poll's trend over time.
explanation.definitionFit: Poll is an old word for head, so balding with age is the condition described.

clue.text: Textile motif is given point by the dance

parts.note: the polka is a lively dance
a dot is a point

explanation.surface: A fabric pattern is sharpened by the dancing.
explanation.definitionFit: A pattern of regular spots on fabric is a common textile design.

clue.text: At sea, fresh food is limited and mixed

indicators.note: mixed means the letters of fresh and the cut-down food are shuffled together
is limited means the word food is cut short, losing its last letter

explanation.surface: Out at sea, fresh provisions are rationed and of mixed quality.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is limited' trims FOOD to FOO; 'mixed' rearranges FRESH plus FOO.
explanation.definitionFit: Away from the coast on the water is a synonym for being at sea.

clue.text: The filament is hard to ventilate

parts.note: H is the abbreviation for hard, as on pencils
to ventilate a room is to air it

explanation.surface: A light-bulb filament is difficult to cool down.
explanation.definitionFit: A single strand growing from the skin is a fine thread, a filament.

clue.text: Paper covering those leaving union meeting

definitions.text: Paper covering those leaving union meeting

parts.words: Paper covering those leaving union meeting
parts.note: the union is a wedding, and the paper is the scraps thrown over the couple as they leave

explanation.surface: Documents handed to members walking out of a trade union meeting.
explanation.definitionFit: Guests shower newly-weds with paper pieces as the couple depart the ceremony.

clue.text: Go in via Durham, for example, then it's over

indicators.note: in places the verb go inside the other pieces

parts.note: by means via
Durham is a county in the North East of England, NE
go as written

explanation.surface: Travel in by way of Durham, and then the journey is done.
explanation.walkthrough: Durham is a county in North East England, abbreviated NE.
explanation.definitionFit: Something past and finished is over and done with.

clue.text: Fraternise, giving superior person place by the fire

parts.note: a hob is a shelf beside a fireplace
a nob is a toff, a person of high social standing

explanation.surface: Being friendly, someone offers a VIP a seat by the hearth.
explanation.walkthrough: A nob is British slang for an upper-class person.
explanation.definitionFit: To socialise familiarly with others is to be friendly, especially with people of higher status.

clue.text: Ornamental embroidery is an extravagant business

parts.note: fancy means elaborate or extravagant
business means work

explanation.surface: Decorative needlework is a costly trade.
explanation.definitionFit: Decorative needlework is an older name for ornamental stitching.

clue.text: Barker of Wimpole Street in funds

definitions.meaning: Elizabeth Barrett's spaniel in Wimpole Street, a dog that barks

explanation.surface: A Wimpole Street shopkeeper named Barker is well off.
explanation.walkthrough: Elizabeth Barrett lived at 50 Wimpole Street in London with her cocker spaniel, subject of Virginia Woolf's novel; 'Barker' is a dog, not a surname.
explanation.definitionFit: Barrett's cocker spaniel bore this name; being well supplied with money is the slang sense.

clue.text: Excuse for shooting together

definitions.meaning: a reservation or evasive excuse, an old sense

explanation.surface: A pretext for firing in unison.
explanation.definitionFit: A volley of gunfire is the usual sense; an evasive excuse or saving clause is the older one.

clue.text: In climbing pass, soldier shows good sense

indicators.note: In puts the soldier inside the other piece
in a down clue climbing means the word for pass reads upward

parts.note: a col is a mountain pass
GI is an American soldier

explanation.surface: A soldier showing sound judgement on a climbing route through mountains.
explanation.walkthrough: 'climbing' turns COL into LOC, and 'In' sets GI inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Reasoned thinking is sound judgement.

clue.text: Hidden meaning of a symbolic kiss

definitions.text: Hidden meaning of a symbolic kiss

parts.words: Hidden meaning of a symbolic kiss
parts.note: the letter X stands for a kiss and, in algebra, for a quantity not yet known

explanation.surface: A secret message behind a kiss.
explanation.definitionFit: Hidden means not known; X marks a kiss and also an algebraic variable whose value is not yet found.

clue.text: Right in the money before start of the dry spell

indicators.note: in places the abbreviation for right inside the slang word for money

parts.note: dough is slang for money

indicators.note: start of picks the first letter of the word the

explanation.surface: Someone flush with cash just before a dry spell begins.
explanation.definitionFit: A long period without rain is a dry spell.

clue.text: Turning point on which a wicket may depend

definitions.meaning: the pivot on which a door or gate swings

definitions.text: on which a wicket may depend
definitions.meaning: a wicket is also a small gate, hung on a pivot

explanation.surface: A crucial moment on which the fall of a wicket depends.
explanation.definitionFit: A pivot is the turning point of a gate; a wicket here is a small gate, not a cricket target.

clue.text: One of Miss Bell's wild companions

definitions.text: One of Miss Bell's wild companions

parts.words: One of Miss Bell's wild companions
parts.note: Miss Bell is a bluebell, and its companions in the wild are other meadow flowers

explanation.surface: A friend of a lady named Bell who runs wild.
explanation.definitionFit: A yellow meadow flower grows wild alongside bluebells.
